import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    # Take exactly n numbers after the first token; if fewer are provided, take all available.
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    
    # Swap first and last using a temporary variable if there are at least 2 elements
    if len(arr) >= 2:
        temp = arr[0]
        arr[0] = arr[-1]
        arr[-1] = temp
    
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, arr)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
